xpath: descendant-or-self::input[(@selected and name(.) = 'option') or (@checked and (name(.) = 'input' or name(.) = 'command')and (@type = 'checkbox' or @type = 'radio'))]
descendant-or-self::article[(not(@class and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' out '))) and (not(@class and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' featured ')))]
descendant-or-self::div[(@class and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' review ')) or (@class and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' notes '))]
descendant-or-self::span[@class and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' price ')]/following-sibling::*[(self::a) and (position() = 1)]
descendant-or-self::*[@href and (name(.) = 'a' or name(.) = 'link' or name(.) = 'area')]

descendant-or-self::*[
        (
            @disabled and
            (
                (name(.) = 'input' and @type != 'hidden') or
                name(.) = 'button' or
                name(.) = 'select' or
                name(.) = 'textarea' or
                name(.) = 'command' or
                name(.) = 'fieldset' or
                name(.) = 'optgroup' or
                name(.) = 'option'
            )
        ) or (
            (
                (name(.) = 'input' and @type != 'hidden') or
                name(.) = 'button' or
                name(.) = 'select' or
                name(.) = 'textarea'
            )
            and ancestor::fieldset[@disabled]
        )
        ]
